description: Implementation of TTSManager class managing text-to-speech operations, including configuration, voice management, speech control, and event callbacks.

classes.name: TTSManager
classes.description: Main class handling Text-To-Speech operations, configurations, speech control, and event callbacks within the TTS namespace.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a new TTSManager object with a specified event callback.

methods.name: enableTTS
methods.description: Enables or disables the TTS engine and updates configuration accordingly.

methods.name: initiateDownload
methods.description: Starts the download process for fallback TTS data if needed.

methods.name: isTTSEnabled
methods.description: Checks if TTS is currently enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: listVoices
methods.description: Lists available voices for a specified language or current configuration.

methods.name: listLocalVoices
methods.description: Lists local voices for a specified language.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Updates TTS configuration parameters such as endpoints, voice, and volume.

methods.name: setFallbackText
methods.description: Sets fallback text data for TTS fallback scenarios.

methods.name: setPrimaryVolDuck
methods.description: Adjusts primary volume ducking level.

methods.name: setAPIKey
methods.description: Sets API key for authentication with TTS services.

methods.name: setACL
methods.description: Sets access control list for method calls.

methods.name: checkAccess
methods.description: Checks if a given callsign has permission to invoke a specific method.

methods.name: getConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves current TTS configuration.

methods.name: speak
methods.description: Initiates speech synthesis for given text with a speech ID and callsign.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses ongoing speech with specified ID.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes paused speech with specified ID.

methods.name: shut
methods.description: Cancels speech with specified ID.

methods.name: isSpeaking
methods.description: Checks if a speech with given ID is currently in progress.

methods.name: getSpeechState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of a speech.

methods.name: willSpeak
methods.description: Callback invoked before speech starts.

methods.name: started
methods.description: Callback invoked when speech starts.

methods.name: spoke
methods.description: Callback invoked when speech completes.

methods.name: paused
methods.description: Callback invoked when speech is paused.

methods.name: resumed
methods.description: Callback invoked when speech is resumed.

methods.name: cancelled
methods.description: Callback invoked when speech is canceled.

methods.name: interrupted
methods.description: Callback invoked when speech is interrupted.

methods.name: networkerror
methods.description: Callback invoked on network errors during speech.

methods.name: playbackerror
methods.description: Callback invoked on playback errors.
